verdict.rationale: Martin documents built-in recurring background tasks: daily or weekly briefings and a wake-up call at a set time every morning. It also offers time-based reminders and custom shortcuts that trigger multi-step actions. However, nothing shows users can put arbitrary or custom workflows (such as shortcuts) on a recurring schedule; the recurrence is limited to predefined task types. Missing for 10: scheduling of user-defined recurring jobs or workflows, documented recurrence options (cron or custom intervals), recurring reminders, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled automation.
